subject: Request: audit access export & sampling plan for SOC 2 review - Healix
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@healixpharm.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: CISO Team <security@healixpharm.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jan 2029 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Audit request: admin access events and export options

Hi Grace / Ben,

We're getting our SOC 2 auditor lined up and they need a reproducible extract of admin/operator actions for the last 90 days. Specifically they asked for: 1) a time-ordered list of admin actions (create/delete/role-change/privilege-escalation) with actor id, target resource, ISO timestamps, and request IDs; 2) evidence that these events are immutable (checksums/signatures or manifest); and 3) suggested retention and sampling approaches while we hand over the bundle.

Can Redwood provide:
- a CSV export schema we can validate against
- recommended sampling matrix (full export vs sampled slices) for a 90-day window
- transfer options (S3 presigned + AES-256, SFTP, or encrypted Drive link)
- expected turnaround for a signed request (healix will provide an approved export form)

We're hoping to include this in the auditor's package by 2029-01-20. Please let me know if you need anything else or if certain event classes aren't retained by default.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Director, IT Compliance
Healix Pharmaceuticals

--
Attachment: request-checklist.pdf (stub: 28KB)

From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@healixpharm.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jan 2029 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Audit request: admin access events and export options

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver an audited export that meets the auditor's needs; below is a high-level plan and an attached sampling_matrix_v1.xlsx (draft).

Plan (summary):
- Export schema: CSV with fields [event_id, timestamp_utc, actor_type, actor_id, actor_email, action, resource_type, resource_id, target_attributes, request_id, correlation_id, ip, region, outcome, raw_payload_hash]. We will provide a header row and a manifest containing SHA256 checksums for each file.
- Immutability: exports are signed server-side (detached signature) and we provide a manifest with checksums + generation timestamp. We can also provide an attest letter for the snapshot generation process.
- Sampling approach: sampling_matrix_v1.xlsx includes three modes — full 90-day export, stratified sampling by role and action type (recommended for initial reviews), and on-demand slices by date range. For SOC 2 it's common to provide a full export for privileged actions and sampled slices for lower-impact operator events.
- Transfer methods: S3 presigned url (restricted to a single origin + expiry) with uploads encrypted at rest (AES-256), or an SFTP push with per-file GPG. We can also stage in your Secure Drive with link expiration.
- Timeline: preliminary export + manifest in 3 business days after signed form; full signed export in 5 business days for 90 days (depends on backlog and size).

Open Qs:
1) Do you need agent-level KV cache deltas or just administrative actions (API/admin console)?
2) Any retention redaction rules we should apply before export (PII masking)?

I've attached the sampling matrix and a short export spec CSV (admin_action_export_spec.csv). Ben and Marcus are looped in to confirm the technical pipeline and to propose transfer specifics.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Manager — Compliance
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: sampling_matrix_v1.xlsx (stub: 84KB), admin_action_export_spec.csv (stub: 6KB)

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@healixpharm.com>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jan 2029 13:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Audit request: admin access events and export options

Laura — quick technical notes and what we'll include in the CSV export. Quoting Grace's list below for context.

On Fri, Jan 11, 2029 at 9:12 AM Laura Chen <laura.chen@healixpharm.com> wrote:
> We're getting our SOC 2 auditor lined up and they need a reproducible extract of admin/operator actions for the last 90 days...

What we'll deliver (technical):
- CSV partitioned by day (one file per UTC date) with the header Grace mentioned. Each file will be accompanied by a .sha256 file containing the hex digest and a signed manifest.json (detached signature: RSA-4096).
- For immutability we provide: manifest + signature + file-level checksums + generation log (who initiated export, job id, node ids). We'll include a text audit trail of the export job steps suitable for legal/forensic review.
- Redaction rules: default export will NOT redact actor_email for admin roles; we can mask non-admin email addresses on request.
- Transfer: S3 presigned put with server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) is preferred; we'll optionally double-encrypt with client-side GPG. ETA: small exports (<= 5GB) in ~24 hours after sign-off; larger exports will be staged and delivered within the 5 business-day window.

Action items I will take:
- Generate a sample CSV for Jan 01-03 to validate header/format (will post to the Drive link listed).
- Provide the S3 bucket details and a step-by-step upload handshake (we'll include the signed manifest in the same upload).

If Healix wants the full 90-day privileged-actions set (recommended), mark that in the signed form and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Lead Security Engineer — Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: export_transfer_instructions.pdf (stub: 12KB)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@healixpharm.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: CISO Team <security@healixpharm.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jan 2029 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Audit request: admin access events and export options

Hi Grace / Ben — thanks for the detailed plan and the attachments. A few quick confirmations: 

- We'll sign and return the export authorization form by Monday 2029-01-15.
- For the auditor package they want full exports for privilege-elevation and role-change events; sampled slices are fine for routine operator events.
- Please use SSE-KMS on the S3 staging bucket and include the detached signature and manifest. We will request a cross-check with the auditor once you drop the sample.

If you can post the Jan 01-03 sample CSV to the Drive link and share the checksum, our compliance team will validate immediately. Also confirm whether TTL/retention metadata is included per file so we can show the auditor our retention policy alignment.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this helps our audit window a lot.

Regards,
Laura Chen
Director, IT Compliance
Healix Pharmaceuticals
